draft:
**Tidepool Landing Page — Build Plan**

Carries over the library's design system: forest green (#173F2E) + coral (#FF6F61), cream backgrounds, day-node sidebar motif, hand-drawn annotations, serif display / sans body / mono quotes.

**1. Hero.** Full-bleed forest green. Vertical Mon–Sun timeline rails down the left edge; coral node dots carry tiny labels ("Standup 9:15," "Maya OOO"). Right of the rail: the headline in a warm serif, cream, one long breathing sentence echoing the house voice: *"Bring your whole team around one living picture of the week that updates the second anything changes, remembers who's out when, and quietly takes the scramble out of Monday morning so nobody misses the meeting that moved."* A hand-drawn coral arrow curls from the last line to a floating app screenshot.

**2. Logo strip.** Cream band, muted wordmarks: "Keeping weeks calm at…" Five logos.

**3. How it works.** Three columns, each headed by a timeline-node icon: *Plan Monday. Adjust as it happens. Close the loop Friday.* Short sans body copy, two sentences each.

**4. Annotated deep-dive.** Split layout: screenshot left, coral hand-drawn circles around drag-to-reschedule, out-of-office badges, and the Friday recap digest; short captions right in sans.

**5. Pull quote.** Cream background, monospace, heavily indented: *"We deleted our Monday status meeting. The week just… exists now."* — attribution in small mono caps.

**6. Pricing.** Two cards on green: Free (solo weeks) and Team ($8/seat), coral highlight on the recommended card.

**7. Final CTA.** Forest green; a second hand-drawn arrow points from "Start this week calmer" at the email input. Coral button: "Plan your week."

**8. Footer.** Minimal cream; the five day-nodes reappear tiny as a signature mark beside the wordmark.
final:
**Tidepool Landing Page — Revised Build Plan**

Key upgrades: the headline is now Tidepool-native instead of a close lift of the shopping-list line; the day-node timeline becomes the page's structural spine rather than hero-only decoration; the hero gains a CTA; the quote and pricing gain specificity.

**1. Hero.** Full-bleed forest green (#173F2E). The Mon–Sun timeline rails down the left; nodes carry live-feeling chips ("Standup moved → 10:30," "Jonas OOO Thu–Fri"). Headline in warm serif, cream, one long stacked-benefit sentence in the house voice: *"Bring your whole team around one living plan of the week that everyone can see and reshape the moment reality changes, remembers who's out and what moved, and quietly takes the scramble out of Monday morning — so nobody shows up to the 9:15 that's secretly a 10:30."* Hand-drawn coral arrow from the final clause to a floating screenshot. Below: email input + coral button ("Plan this week"), mono microline: "Free for your first five weeks."

**2. Proof strip.** Cream band, five muted wordmarks; small sans caption: "Keeping weeks calm at…"

**3. How it works — as the timeline itself.** Drop the three columns; the hero rail visually continues down the page. Three nodes labeled Mon / Wed / Fri: *Sketch the week together*, *Adjust as it happens*, *Close the loop* (Friday digest). Two sans sentences each.

**4. Annotated deep-dive.** Screenshot left; coral hand-drawn circles on drag-to-reschedule, OOO badges, and the digest. Captions right, styled as calendar entries: "Wed 11:02 — moved, everyone notified."

**5. Pull quote as a timeline node.** Cream section; the block is stamped like a "Fri 4:30 PM" calendar entry. Monospace: *"We deleted our Monday status meeting. The week just… exists now."* Attribution in small mono caps.

**6. Pricing.** Two cards on green: Free (solo weeks), Team $8/seat (shared weeks, integrations, digests); coral outline marks Team. One mono objection-line beneath: "Already use a calendar? Tidepool sits on top of it."

**7. Final CTA.** Forest green; second hand-drawn arrow from "Start this week calmer" to the email input; coral button.

**8. Footer.** Cream; the five day-nodes shrink to a signature mark beside the wordmark.
